cover.coreProposition: Continuity state may remain useful without remaining sovereign; each effect-bearing operation needs an explicit current authority owner, a deterministic precedence operator and preserved safe controls before mutation.
cover.visualMetaphor: A retained silver ribbon continues through three distinct boundary devices: a comparison prism, a replacement seal, and an isolated vault.
cover.semanticObject: Continuous silver state ribbon passing a cyan prism, amber ownership seal, and protected violet vault
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover on deep navy with one continuous ribbon, three visually distinct authority boundaries, restrained cyan violet and amber accents, and generous negative space
